purpose: Validates a CCTP v2 cross-chain USDC transfer for domain pair eligibility, Fast Transfer 30-second finality risk (LP availability), Hook payload safety, CCTP v1 sunset migration status (31 Jul 2026), and large-notional LP-depth risk. 6 checks, A–F grade. 13 CCTP v2 domains as of Oct 2025.
